triage: herdr-review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Start at `triageHeader`. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Quotation | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog, in the order given — `section: consensus` rows first, adjacent rows already together. A row's `adjacency.withRows` names the others in its group: put a group to ONE decision. A row carrying `priorDecision` was rejected or deferred before — its reason is on the row, and re-raising it needs new evidence. Then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, approve the consensus section wholesale, or decide row by row — and either of the first two ends that part in ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision first, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason. ON ROUND 2 the re-verification rows are findings of FACT: confirm or correct them against the code and do NOT offer Reject or Defer on them — only rows still open after re-verification, and new findings, take the full triage. A `question` row is resolved by asking the reviewer IN ITS PANE: it is still running, `panel.members[].tabId` names it. WHEN TRIAGE IS DONE, close each open member pane with `herdr tab close <tabId>` — this gate deliberately left them open for you and nothing else will. Echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration — the conductors parse it, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.
